title: Canceling a payment
summary: This document explains how to cancel a pending payment: you may cancel within 17 minutes of submission if it hasn’t been claimed or posted. It provides step-by-step instructions (Activity → select pending payment → Cancel → confirm) and what to do if cancellation isn’t possible (request a return or initiate a dispute).
